title: Brand
description: Changes the brand of an existing webapp and rebuilds every file that depends on it: the palette in src/constants/theme.js, the theme colour, the sign-in ground, logos, favicons, PWA icons, the share image and the web manifest.

action.description: colors: change the palette; logo: use the person's own logo; assets: rebuild the derived files from the current brand; og: rebuild the share image

brandMode.description: Start the palette over from Mi Retail's, a preset or a random one (without it, the current palette is kept)

logo.description: Path to the logo for light backgrounds (SVG, or PNG of at least 512 px)

logoDark.description: Path to the logo for the header and dark backgrounds (defaults to logo)

mark.description: Path to a square symbol for favicons and the condensed sidebar

tagline.description: Line under the name in the share image (defaults to the package description)
